title: Charming 3‑BR 30A Coastal Vacation Home with Beach Access
meta_description: Stay at The Ocean Pearl, a 3-BR, 2.5-bath 30A vacation retreat with a communal pool, golf cart, and beach access. Accommodates 6 guests.
description_expanded: The Ocean Pearl is a charming 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom coastal retreat in the heart of Seagrove Beach. This 2-story home comfortably accommodates up to 6 guests, making it an ideal choice for families or groups seeking a serene getaway.As you step into The Ocean Pearl, you'll immediately feel at home. The property features modern comforts for your entertainment, while its charming balconies provide relaxing spots to unwind after your coastal explorations. The fully equipped kitchen makes meal prep a breeze. Enjoy your morning coffee before stepping out to explore this slice of paradise.Dining options are abundant, with local favorites like Brozinni’s Pizzeria and Angelina’s just a short stroll away. For an upscale experience, make a reservation at Café Thirty-A, or pedal over to Goatfeather’s Seafood for the freshest catches of the day. Your rental even includes the convenience of a golf cart to explore the surrounding area.And, of course, the beach is just a quick 5-minute walk away. You'll find yourself on the nearby public beach access, where the kids can build sandcastles, you can take a relaxing beach stroll, or the whole family can enjoy a splash in the clear emerald waters of the Gulf. Cool down in the nearby community pool after a fun day at the beach. And if you're wanting to dine in, take advantage the grill right at home, perfect for cooking up a feast after a day filled with fun.Sleeping Arrangements:Bedroom 1: King bed. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo.Bedroom 2: Full bed.Bedroom 3: Full bed.Bedroom 2 & 3 share a bathroom with tub/shower combo.Beach Access:Head across 30A to Seagrove Place. Take this until it ends at your beach access, One Seagrove Place.Distance: .2 miles | Time: 5 minutes walkingSeagrove Beach:Named for the thick grove of oak trees lining its coastline, Seagrove Beach is located in the heart of 30A. There's no better spot to experience everything 30A has to offer! Feeling adventurous? Rent a bike and jump on the 20-mile Timpoochee bike trail that runs right in front of the building. Visit famous Seaside and Grayton Beach State Park to the West. Head East and discover more of Seagrove Beach plus the wonderful coastal communities of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Enjoy exploring the boutique shops, fabulous restaurants, and beautiful state parks in each of these communities.Your stay at The Ocean Pearl comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure! * Parking for 2 cars. * Sorry, no pets allowed.An initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
